about: T-430, what you bring keeps its colour in HALFTONE (2026-10-21). The first sight's failed flicker, once; the player and the follower in colour in a grey town, walking and on the bike; the START menu grey; a wild battle in DAEMON TOWER -- your daemon and your back in colour, the foe and the healthboxes grey; your routine in flight (colour fading as it crosses) and at impact (a splash of colour on the foe); the foe's routine grey; PERSPECTIVE's flash still whole; the tower floor by floor back in colour once INIT is rescued, the town still grey; and (T-18 follow-up) the follower going into the CHECKPOINT's machine and coming back out. Lead friendship 255 so its colour shows. Debug scratch save: the flags it changes are put back at the end.
